title: [SOLVED] Need help adapting PKGBUILD for abandoned AUR package
body: I want to use a package from the AUR which is abandoned (flagged out-of-date for more than 6 months without reaction) and adapt the PKGBUILD for the latest version for needed features. I am stumped how to do this since I rarely deal with this particular PKGBUILD feature, the PKGBUILDs I modified in the past were basic and easily adaptable. The PKGBUILD is from the package turing-smart-screen-python: https://aur.archlinux.org/cgit/aur.git/ … een-python I can deal with changing the version numbers and adding the new dependency of libusb, also updating the checksum for the first file. What I don't know is where the last 4 files with checksums come from, and because of this, I cannot adjust the checksums except for the first file (archive from github). Help is appreciated. I don't expect that someone changes the PKGBUILD for me, just a pointer in the right direction would be great. Last edited by emk2203 (2026-10-16 11:04:45)
